text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said it will launch a non-stop daily service to Vancouver, British Columbia from its Houston hub on June 12.

The flight will depart Houston at 1100EST/1600GMT and arrive in Vancouver at 1546EST/2046GMT. The return flight from Vancouver will depart at 1705EST/2205EST and arrive in Houston at 2136EST/0236GMT. The Vancouver flight will operate on a 128-seat Boeing 737 jet.
Continental said connections from Vancouver to other destinations in Canada as well as Asia will be available via Continental's code-share partner, Air Canada.
Continental said it intends to add additional service from Houston to Vancouver and Toronto in 1998.
Continental Airlines is the fifth largest airline in the U.S.
